## Type

- [ ] feat — user-visible new capability
- [ ] fix — user-visible bug fix
- [ ] chore — maintenance, no behavior change
- [ ] docs — documentation only
- [ ] refactor — code reshuffle, no behavior change
- [ ] test — tests only
- [ ] build — Gradle / dependencies
- [ ] ci — workflow files

<!-- What did you add or change in the test suite? If "none", justify. -->

## Screenshots / screen recording

<!-- Mandatory for any UI-visible change. Drag & drop here. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title is a valid Conventional Commit
- [ ] `./gradlew check` passes locally
- [ ] Unit tests added/updated for new logic
- [ ] UI tests added/updated for new critical flows
- [ ] Documentation updated (README, in-code KDoc, ADR if architectural)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or keystore material added to the repo
- [ ] No new permissions added without updating README "Permissions explained"
- [ ] If this changes device behavior, a device profile entry has been added/updated
